rows.text: when qword `rcx+8` is non-null passes it to the call at `003DEFC0` + 0x21 and zeroes it, and when qword `rcx+0x18` is non-null passes it to the call at + 0x37 and zeroes it (each skipped when null); then stores byte 0 at `rcx+0x10` and clears bit `r8d` (shift count `cl`, so modulo 32) of the dword at `02B59C20` + sign-extended `edx` times 4

notes: 003DEFC0: the same callee is reached from both sites; it is cited by site per the homing rule.
